column1: # bridge/shlib/test.tsv: the gate's test library (bridge/shlib/shlib.om lib) and its probe (shlib.om call).
# The probe compares the low 32 bits of each result. 4294967293 is the int -3 with a zero upper half and
# 16045690981097406469 the int 5 under 0xdeadbeef: omc needs both sign-extended. Its int add checks that the
# 64-bit sum is an int (CMP X0, W0, SXTW) and traps otherwise, so call 1 fails without the wrapper's sign
# extension (999 for 7), as does call 5 (-9 div 3, a 64-bit division); call 9 (0xdeadbeef00010000 shifted
# right 16 as a uint) fails without zero extension.
# div by 0 traps 2 inside omc code; the library returns the trap value 999.
# buf is one shared 4096-byte buffer: put writes its second uint, a later get reads it back.
# sum needs 8 KiB of stack and deep 16 KiB through a private call: the wrapper probes those pages first.
